systems.tiers: named as Côte d'Ivoire's e-learning platforms; UVCI is higher education, outside the study's levels

note: A six-country digital inclusion baseline. For Côte d'Ivoire it names the SNDECI 2024-2028 only as a costed education digitalisation strategy led by the education ministry, with no system under it, and otherwise covers connectivity, budgets, hubs and e-learning; it names no system holding learner records and says nothing of how schools keep them.
